content: संपद् €4 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To turn out well, succeed, prosper, be accomplished or fulfilled; संपत्स्यते वः कामोऽयं कालः कश्चित् प्रतीक्ष्यताम् <ls>Ku. 2. 54</ls>; <ls>R. 14. 76</ls>; <ls>Ms. 3. 254</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">6. 69</ls>. .²2 To be completed, to amount to (as a number); त्र्याहताः पञ्च पञ्चदश संपद्यन्ते. .²3 To turn out to be, become; संपत्स्यन्ते नभसि भवतो राजहंसाः सहायाः <ls>Me. 11</ls>, <ls n="Me.">23</ls>; संपेदे श्रमसलिलोद्गमो विभूषाम् <ls>Ki. 7. 5</ls>. .²4 To arise, be born or produced. .²5 To fall or come together, unite. .²6 To be provided or furnished with, be possessed of; अशोक यदि सद्य एव कुसुमैर्न संपत्स्यसे <ls>M. 3. 16</ls>; see संपन्न. .²7 To tend to, bring about, produce (with <ab>dat.</ab>); साधोः शिक्षा गुणाय संपद्यते नासाधोः <ls>Pt. 1</ls>; <ls>Mu. 3. 32</ls>. .²8 To obtain, attain to, acquire, get. .²9 To enter into, be absorbed in (with <ab>loc.</ab>). --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To cause to happen, bring about, produce, accomplish, fulfil, effect; इति स्वसुर्भोजकुलप्रदीपः संपाद्य पाणिग्रहणं स राजा <ls>R. 7. 29</ls>. .²2 To procure, obtain, make ready, prepare. .²3 To obtain, acquire, attain to. .²4 To furnish, provide, endow with. .²5 To change or transform into. .²6 To make an agreement.

संपद् {%f.%} .²1 Wealth, riches; नीताविवोत्साहगुणेन संपद् <ls>Ku. 1. 22</ls>; आपन्नार्तिप्रशमनफलाः संपदो ह्युत्तमानाम् <ls>Me. 55</ls>. .²2 Prosperity, affluence, advancement; (<ab>opp.</ab> विपद् or आपद्); ते भृत्या नृपतेः कलन्नमितरे संपत्सु चापत्सु च <ls>Mu. 1. 15</ls>. .²3 Good fortune, happiness, luck; <ls>Bg. 16. 3</ls>. .²4 Success, fulfilment, accomplishment of desired objects; तव प्रसादस्य पुरस्तु संपदः <ls>Ś. 7. 30</ls>. .²5 Perfection, excellence; as in रूपसंपद्; त्वष्टुः सदाभ्यासगृहीतशिल्पविज्ञानसंपत् प्रसरस्य सीमा <ls>Śi. 3. 35</ls>. .²6 Richness, plenty, exuberance, abundance, excess; तुषारवृष्टिक्षतपद्मसंपदाम् <ls>Ku. 5. 27</ls>; <ls>R. 10. 59</ls>. .²7 Treasure. .²8 An advantage, a benefit, blessing. .²9 Advancement in good qualities. .²10 Decoration. .²11 Right method. .²12 A necklace of pearls. .²13 Attainment, acquisition; अथ संपदः <ls>Bṛ. Up. 3. 1. 6</ls>.
